caption: Two stacks of books, one larger and one smaller, begin to slide smoothly across a wooden surface. The larger stack, consisting of three books, is very heavy, and it moves steadily, maintaining its neat alignment. The smaller stack, with a single book, glides with a gentle motion. The warm tones of the book covers contrast subtly with the light wood grain, creating a harmonious visual as they move in unison.
